budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Roles 0/1 coordinate to deliver the parcel through one of two exits; roles 2/3 coordinate to intercept. Scouts provide expiring route intelligence and operate corridor gates.
task.natural_termination: Interceptor action 7 within Manhattan distance one of the courier captures the parcel; otherwise courier action 7 on either exit delivers it. Capture has explicit priority if both triggers occur. Horizon 80 truncates as an unresolved draw.
task.interaction: Scouts can traverse closed gates, cache local gate/opponent facts and explicitly relay them. A teammate gains access to those facts, while opponents near the transmitter can intercept the same report. Gate toggles change others' movement; public lures can redirect behavior but are never ground-truth contacts.
task.observation_access: Radar-style local sensing has Manhattan radius three for scouts and one for main roles, without wall occlusion. Only scouts see their own notebook. A radio message is accessible to its team and roles within radius two at the actual broadcast, until TTL expires. Public map reveals gate sites only. Unverified lures and public terminal outcome are separated from actual locally observed contacts.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public unverified signals emitted this transition by team
Current public outcome: 0 unresolved, 1 delivered, 2 intercepted

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
